capabilities: Sync vault files two-way with Baidu Netdisk
Keep conflict copies and offer a side-by-side diff view for merging
Pair devices by exporting and importing an encrypted pairing code
Show live transfer progress and set upload/download concurrency
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.14.4 or newer; the README warns that older clients may install a historical version instead. Setup needs a free Baidu Netdisk developer application and OAuth authorization, and tokens renew automatically. Guides are in Chinese and English, with architecture notes in DEVELOPER.md.
motivation: The author wanted Baidu Netdisk users to have a native, stable and safe way to keep their vault in the cloud, using its large free storage and fast domestic CDN nodes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault through Baidu Netdisk, and careless file sync can overwrite notes edited on two devices.

relations.evidence: Inspired by owl234/obsidian-baidu-netdisk-sync for end-to-end encryption concepts.
designed for users who wish to use Baidu Netdisk as their primary cloud knowledge base storage

summary: Two-way sync plugin that mirrors a vault to Baidu Netdisk, with conflict copies, optional AES-256 encryption and a live progress card.
